priorTwenty.status: already viewed; reuse exact 180-scenario ledger after verifying source and assumptions

newMethodGrid.rule: Compare current price with price lookbackTicks genuine contiguous ticks earlier. Trend follows the difference; reverse opposes it; tie abstains.
Require length consecutive strictly same-sign one-tick changes. Trend follows that sign; reverse opposes it; otherwise abstain.
Compare current price with simple moving average including the current tick. Trend follows the difference; reverse opposes it; equality abstains.

When the current absolute one-tick change is strictly greater than multiplier times mean absolute change over the last 20 changes (including current), trend follows the change or reverse opposes it; zero change or zero mean abstains.

timing.resetAt: every missing tick and chronological segment boundary
timing.noCrossing: decision, delayed entry and settlement must remain in the same contiguous segment

ranking.rankOn: worst modeled average signed return over 30-day middle, 30-day late and both seven-hour halves, across all three delays at primary payout; only methods meeting trade-count floors are ranked first
ranking.developmentPass: all four segments positive at every delay at +0.8 payout, and both late segments positive at every delay at +0.7 payout
ranking.noSelectionException: If none passes, report NO TRADE, not a forced winner. Even a development pass is not trading authorization.

knownLimitations: The earlier two-week period is contained inside the 30-day archive and is not independent evidence.
The first 20 candidates and both series were viewed before these 30 extra variants were added; all results are development evidence, not a pristine holdout.
The seven-hour composite contains 220 later-recovered historical seconds and is not an untouched live test.
All payouts and entry delays are assumptions; actual executable contract payouts and Deriv Bot tick/indicator parity are unverified.
Variants within one family are correlated; 50 comparisons increase selection/overfitting risk.
